assessment_issue.description: The auth.test tool observation at /steps/8/observation/stdout (and /steps/9) returns team display name 'Workspace T100', which conflicts with the ground-truth team_name 'Nimbus Robotics' recorded at initial_state /teams/0 for team_id T100. This is a seed/tool-data inconsistency, not an agent reference error, since the agent correctly relied on the supplied tool output and correctly resolved the required team_id T100.
